t: Which of the following hydrides has the least boiling point?

The boiling of water is highest due to the presence of H -bonding which is more strong than Vander Waal force of attraction. In H₂S,H₂Se and H₂Te. There is no H -bonding, therefore boiling point depends on an Vander Waal force which is directly proportional to the molecular weight of molecules. Hence, the boiling point of H₂O is maximum and that of H₂S
is minimum.
